sub_agent_reviews.summary: Unified Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety in one candidate table; selected CompactionRL after excluding same-day FORGE, Direct-OPD, LangGraph, and Agentic Test-Time Training duplicates.
Read arXiv HTML, arXiv Atom metadata, benchmark context pages, and Harbor repository page; extracted method, formulas, experiments, ablations, figures, limitations, and benchmark caveats.
Markdown uses h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URLs are embedded because the evidence is reconstructed textually.
